description: Prefill-focused service workloads and service-captured forward/operator replays. Planning only.

historical-conversations.history: dataset assistant history, not model-generated conversation
historical-conversations.token_lengths: actual post-template tokenizer lengths; no forced truncation

cold-miss.required_state: weights/JIT warm; reusable prefix/KV cold across every enabled tier
cold-miss.preparation: drain; flush or isolate all served cache tiers; confirm completion; independent prefixes within each concurrent wave
cold-miss.verification: prefill owner request-level counters; cached tokens must be zero; no random salt length extension
cold-miss.unsupported_action: blocked or inconclusive, never assume a miss

partial-50.preparation: warm only the token-aligned common prefix; keep remaining suffix uncached
partial-50.verification: compare actual cached/new tokens against page-aligned target; tolerance=max(0.02, page_tokens/prompt_tokens)

partial-90.preparation: warm only the token-aligned common prefix; keep remaining suffix uncached
partial-90.verification: compare actual cached/new tokens against page-aligned target; tolerance=max(0.02, page_tokens/prompt_tokens)

warm-full-prefix.preparation: replay identical prompt after warmup, with frozen cache namespace
warm-full-prefix.verification: record mandatory tail recomputation/page rounding; never require zero work if backend recomputes logits
warm-full-prefix.no_forward_work: service remains valid; forward/operator entry marked not_applicable with evidence, not zero-time speedup

natural-history.preparation: frozen disjoint per-user histories, deterministic session order; do not cycle dataset
natural-history.verification: measure actual token-weighted hit rate by length/turn/tenant; do not assert an arbitrary 90% target

eviction-churn.preparation: construct rotating working set relative to measured reusable KV capacity
eviction-churn.verification: record reuse distance, eviction/reload, tier-hit counters, admission and recovery

host-restore.required_capability: verified host-tier cache and per-tier observability
host-restore.preparation: device tier cold, host tier warm, storage excluded or separately accounted
host-restore.verification: prefill-owner host restore counters plus response parity; client metadata alone is insufficient

storage-restore.required_capability: verified storage-tier cache and per-tier observability
storage-restore.preparation: device/host cold; storage data published and restore completion observable
storage-restore.verification: prefill-owner storage restore counters and publication/ready events; no guessed availability

smoke.role: correctness/smoke only; no promotion or tail-SLO claims

cold-fixed-work.warmup: up to 8 rounds; latest 3 elapsed spreads <3% and no new JIT
cold-fixed-work.cache_reset: before each round after drain, never flush while measuring another wave

cache-fixed-work.warmup: JIT warm first, then establish exactly the declared cache state
cache-fixed-work.drain: all submitted requests terminal; re-establish state identically for each arm/round

locust-fixed-work.partition: global seed + worker id + user id, disjoint sessions across workers
locust-fixed-work.drain: finish fixed work and every in-flight SSE; include final drain in elapsed

locust-steady.role: one complete run is stability evidence only; performance claims require independent repeated paired runs and confidence gate

locust-ramp.report: each plateau and complete ramp; user count is not fixed RPS

burst-recovery.report: per-burst queue/TTFT plus recovery to pre-burst service health

arrival-rate.reference_rate: freeze baseline sustainable rate from separate calibration
arrival-rate.report: offered/admitted/completed/rejected rates, client dispatch lateness and server queue
arrival-rate.role: characterization above saturation; distinct from Locust user-based closed loop

cache-pressure.working_set_basis: measured reusable KV capacity after static allocations
cache-pressure.report: per-tier hit/eviction, memory, stalls, retraction and post-pressure recovery

tier-restore.report: per-tier restore, ready/publication timing, actual new tokens and response parity

context-boundary.admission: check actual model context and owned memory before each condition
context-boundary.report: supported cases qualify normally; unsupported cases explicitly blocked or not_applicable

service.boundary: request send to first semantic token; include HTTP/router/queue/transfer; not pure forward latency
service.throughput_boundary: fixed work: first send to last terminal SSE; timed load: report offered window plus fully drained cohort window separately

forward.boundary: actual prefill/extend model forward with all participating streams joined; record per-rank intervals, never sum ranks as wall time
forward.sampling_and_http: excluded; logits/head inclusion explicitly fixed in capture manifest

operator.boundary: captured operator call contract; full wrapper and kernel-only intervals labeled separately
operator.weighting: service-captured call count/shape/routing weights; never unweighted mean of speedup ratios
operator.promotion: requires forward and service requalification for the same workload ids

integrity.qualification: zero HTTP/transport/SSE/parse errors, zero missing terminal markers, one generated token and valid finish reason; no unfinished or silently retried requests
integrity.input_identity: exact tokenized prompt/template/tokenizer/seed/output-cap manifest matched across arms; requested lengths verified after tokenization
integrity.correctness: paired first-token IDs all equal; forward/operator tolerances must reference an explicit model/dtype contract, checked before and after timing on all ranks
integrity.formal_runtime: no new JIT, profiler, debug synchronization, GPU faults, watchdogs, unexpected restarts, OOM or retractions in qualification

tail_samples.below_minimum: inconclusive for that tail metric, not automatic pass

integrity.missing_absolute_slo: relative regression verdict only; production SLO acceptance remains unconfigured

cache.cold: actual reusable cached tokens exactly zero on the prefill owner across enabled tiers
cache.controlled_partial: actual hit fraction within max(2 percentage points, one page/prompt length) of page-aligned target
cache.warm_full: tail recomputation/page rounding explicitly accounted; low/no new work never claimed as higher compute throughput
cache.natural_or_pressure: observed hit distribution reported and paired by manifest/turn; no invented target
cache.tier_attribution: per-owner stage/request accounting without TP/PP duplicate counts; report raw tier definitions and avoid double-counting inclusive counters

service.comparison: same condition and cache evidence; natural-history hit/mix changes require stratification before compute claims

operator.numeric_tolerance: required explicit reference contract; no universal FP8/INT4 tolerance
operator.synthetic_routing: diagnostic only unless shown representative by service capture

promotion.paired_confidence: 95% interval lower bound >0, resample rounds/sessions rather than correlated tokens
promotion.guardrails: all required conditions pass non-regression and correctness; no demand that every condition improve 3%
promotion.status: design policy only; current planner does not evaluate runtime reports

acceptance.characterization: above-saturation or capacity searches report clean rejection/queue/recovery separately; expected overload is not qualification success or a serving gain

capture_contract.source: separate representative capture after unprofiled service timing, same frozen workload and cache preparation
capture_contract.linkage: service workload -> actual prefill steps -> actual operator calls; concurrency is not microbatch size and prompt length is not uncached query length
capture_contract.missing_capture: planned/unbound diagnostic only, never service-aligned qualification

requirements: report TTFT and completions by length bucket; no aggregate masking of long/short starvation
complete entire planned 20-minute offered window and drain; preserve every error and unfinished request
